admin_renounced.description: `true` once `RenounceDenomAdmin` has relinquished this contract's tokenfactory admin over the denom (finding C-M2).

choice_factory.description: Audit field — `Some(addr)` if `RegisterLaunch` chained an `AddNativeTokenDecimals` call to a `choice_factory`. `None` if the consumer dApp opted out and is registering decimals separately.

oneOf.description: `RegisterLaunch` succeeded: denom created, total_supply minted to self, `evm_supply` sent to `evm_authority`, `cw_held` retained. `MsgCreateTokenPair` + seeder factory's `CreateSink` were emitted in the same tx — if either fails the whole tx reverts, so this state implies both landed.
`DeliverToSeeder` succeeded: leftover burned from `evm_authority`, `cw_held` sent to `seeder_addr`. Terminal state on the happy path.

`RefundFailedLaunch` succeeded: `cw_held` burned (self) AND the unsold EVM-side supply held by `evm_authority` admin-burned (capped at `evm_supply`), so no dangling launch-denom supply lingers on either side. Terminal state on the failure path.
